en: Black‑and‑white view of a street corner with a large, ornate late‑19th/early‑20th‑century apartment and commercial building. The structure has four to five storeys with mansard roofs, dormer windows, decorative stonework and small wrought‑iron balconies. Ground‑floor shopfronts with large display windows line both visible sides. Several pedestrians stand on the sidewalk. Visible shop signs read "HERMES" high on the corner façade and again above a storefront, along with German‑language shop names on neighboring stores.
